This recipe list is found at the Ganador Command Center (reached from any port in the world by clicking the Special Transport Ship button). Talk to the Military Man, and click Production to view the available recipes.

Required:
50 Broken Cannon
50 Ripped Sails
50 Broken Armour

Middle rank Ganador exchange (r1 Storage) -- Ganador Prize Exchange Box 2
Required:
100 Broken Cannon
100 Ripped Sails
100 Broken Armour

High rank Ganador exchange (r1 Storage) -- Ganador Prize Exchange Box 3
Required:
150 Broken Cannon
150 Ripped Sails
150 Broken Armour
